guideContent.strategyOverview:
Gandalf the White is a mono-white artifact value engine disguised as a Tolkien character. His two abilities — granting flash to legendary and artifact spells, and doubling triggered abilities caused by legendary permanents or artifacts entering/leaving the battlefield — turn mediocre ETB/LTB artifacts into absurd card advantage machines.

The deck operates on three axes. First: the value grind. Cheap artifacts like Ichor Wellspring draw 2 on entry and 2 on death. Solemn Simulacrum ramps 2 and draws 2. Archaeomancer's Map fetches 4 Plains. Every piece of scrap generates double returns. Second: the recursion loop. Myr Retriever, Scrap Trawler, Junk Diver, and Workshop Assistant all return 2 artifacts on death instead of 1, creating a self-sustaining engine that recycles spent resources. Cost reducers (Foundry Inspector, Cloud Key, Jhoira's Familiar) make replaying these pieces free or near-free. Third: the combo kill. Heliod + Walking Ballista is the cleanest win — both castable at flash speed via Gandalf. KCI + Nim Deathmantle + Myr Battlesphere generates infinite mana and tokens. Aetherflux Reservoir converts the artifact storm into lethal damage.

The stax package leverages Gandalf's flash ability to deploy disruptive pieces at instant speed. Ethersworn Canonist, Boromir, Karn the Great Creator, and Elesh Norn can all enter at the most devastating moment. Elesh Norn with Gandalf means your ETBs trigger three times while opponents get zero.

B4 fast mana (Sol Ring, Chrome Mox, Ancient Tomb) enables T3-4 Gandalf deployment. From there, the deck snowballs through doubled triggers until it assembles a combo or buries opponents in card advantage.

deckCategories.name: ETB/LTB Value Engine
deckCategories.description: Cheap artifacts that generate double value with Gandalf on board. Ichor Wellspring draws 4 total across ETB and death. Solemn ramps 2 and draws 2. Archaeomancer's Map fetches 4 Plains.

deckCategories.name: Recursion Network
deckCategories.description: Artifact recursion pieces that each return 2 artifacts on death with Gandalf. Teshar triggers off casting historic spells to reanimate CMC 3 or less permanents. Sun Titan recurs 2 cheap permanents per ETB. Together they create an engine that never runs out of resources.

deckCategories.name: Cost Reduction
deckCategories.description: Artifact cost reducers that enable free casting and combo loops. With 2-3 reducers in play, most value artifacts cost zero mana, enabling rapid artifact storms and infinite recursion loops.

deckCategories.name: Combo Finishers
deckCategories.description: Three main combo lines. Heliod gives Walking Ballista lifelink; each ping gains life, triggers Heliod to add a counter, repeat infinitely. KCI sacrifices Myr Battlesphere + Myr for mana, Nim Deathmantle reanimates it with 8 new Myr (doubled by Gandalf), netting infinite mana and tokens. Aetherflux Reservoir converts artifact storm turns into 50-damage shots.

deckCategories.name: Stax & Flash Disruption
deckCategories.description: Disruptive permanents deployable at instant speed via Gandalf. Ethersworn Canonist limits opponents to one non-artifact spell per turn. Karn shuts down all opposing artifact activated abilities. Boromir counters free spells. Elesh Norn blanks all opponent ETBs while tripling yours with Gandalf.

deckCategories.name: Blink & Protection
deckCategories.description: Effects that re-trigger ETBs or protect the board. Ephemerate rebounds for two blinks. Semester's End saves from board wipes and adds +1/+1 counters on return. Teleportation Circle provides repeatable end-step blinks. The Eternal Wanderer blinks creatures at combat.

deckCategories.name: Threats & Removal
deckCategories.description: High-impact creatures and removal. Wurmcoil Engine creates 4 tokens on death. Ao the Dawn Sky's doubled death trigger looks at 14 cards or distributes +4/+4 counters. Angel of the Ruins exiles 4 artifacts/enchantments. Duplicant exiles 2 creatures.

deckCategories.name: Ramp & Card Advantage
deckCategories.description: Fast mana for T3-4 Gandalf deployment, card advantage engines, and tutors. Mystic Forge plays artifacts from the top. Skullclamp draws 4 per small creature death with Gandalf. Panharmonicon triples ETBs alongside Gandalf.

winConditions.title: Heliod + Walking Ballista
winConditions.description: Heliod gives Walking Ballista lifelink. Remove a +1/+1 counter to ping any target for 1 damage. Lifelink gains 1 life, triggering Heliod to place a +1/+1 counter on Ballista. Repeat infinitely for lethal. Both pieces are castable at flash speed via Gandalf — Heliod is legendary, Ballista is an artifact. This lets you steal wins during opponents' counter wars.

sources.name: Jurassic Magic — Gandalf cEDH Deck Tech
sources.detail: Primary cEDH win condition, both pieces flash-castable via Gandalf

winConditions.title: KCI + Nim Deathmantle + Myr Battlesphere
winConditions.description: Sacrifice Myr Battlesphere and 4 Myr tokens to KCI for 10 mana. Battlesphere's death triggers Nim Deathmantle — pay 4 to reanimate. With Gandalf, Battlesphere creates 8 Myr instead of 4, so you still have 4 Myr leftover. Net: +6 mana, +4 Myr per loop. Infinite mana, infinite tokens. Feed into Walking Ballista or Aetherflux Reservoir for the kill.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: KCI combo enhanced by Gandalf's doubled Myr token production

winConditions.title: Artifact Storm + Aetherflux Reservoir
winConditions.description: With 2-3 cost reducers in play, cast and sacrifice cheap artifacts repeatedly via the Scrap Trawler + Myr Retriever recursion loop. Each cast triggers Aetherflux Reservoir's lifegain, which scales quadratically with spell count. After 7-8 casts you're gaining 20+ life per spell. Activate Reservoir's 50-life ability to dome each opponent.

sources.name: ErrorDoggo — $50 Gandalf Deck Tech
sources.detail: Cost reduction + recursion loop into Aetherflux kill

winConditions.title: Token Overwhelming
winConditions.description: Myr Battlesphere with Gandalf creates 8 Myr tokens. Wurmcoil Engine creates 4 tokens on death (2 lifelink + 2 deathtouch). Ao the Dawn Sky's doubled death trigger dumps nonland permanents onto the battlefield or distributes +4/+4 in counters. Combined with Skullclamp and recursion, the board becomes overwhelming without requiring a combo.

sources.name: Command Power — Gandalf Deck Tech
sources.detail: Token army alternative win via doubled ETB/LTB production

synergies.description: Two-mana artifact that draws 2 on ETB (doubled) and draws 2 on death (doubled). Flash it in at end of turn for instant divination. With recursion, each cycle through Ichor Wellspring draws 4 total cards for 2 mana.

synergies.title: Gandalf + Archaeomancer's Map
synergies.description: The Map is an artifact with an ETB that searches for basic Plains. With Gandalf, it fetches 4 Plains instead of 2 on entry, solving mono-white's land scarcity problem. The Map's second ability passively puts Plains into play when opponents play lands.

sources.name: ErrorDoggo — $50 Gandalf Deck Tech

synergies.title: Gandalf + Myr Battlesphere
synergies.description: Battlesphere creates 4 Myr tokens on ETB, doubled to 8 by Gandalf. That's 12 power across 9 bodies for 7 mana at instant speed. Combined with Skullclamp or KCI, those tokens convert into massive card advantage or mana.

sources.name: Command Power — Gandalf Deck Tech
sources.detail: 8 Myr tokens highlighted as signature Gandalf play

synergies.title: Gandalf + Angel of the Ruins
synergies.description: Angel exiles up to 2 artifacts and/or enchantments on ETB. With Gandalf, it exiles 4. At flash speed, this is a one-sided Farewell for permanents-only that leaves a 5/7 flyer behind. Plainscycling provides flexibility when you don't need the ETB.

synergies.title: Scrap Trawler + Myr Retriever Loop
synergies.description: When both die simultaneously (sacrificed together to KCI or another effect), Gandalf doubles their death triggers. Each sees the other die: Myr Retriever returns Scrap Trawler, Scrap Trawler returns Myr Retriever, plus 2 additional artifact returns. Infinite recursion with enough cost reduction.

synergies.title: Elesh Norn + Gandalf Triple ETBs
synergies.description: Elesh Norn doubles ETBs while blanking opponents' ETBs entirely. Combined with Gandalf's doubling, your artifact and legendary ETBs trigger three times total. Opponents get zero. Ichor Wellspring draws 3. Myr Battlesphere makes 12 tokens. Solemn Simulacrum ramps 3.

synergies.title: Oswald Fiddlebender Toolbox
synergies.description: Oswald sacrifices an artifact to tutor one with CMC +1, putting it directly onto the battlefield. Gandalf gives Oswald flash (legendary creature), so you can deploy and immediately activate. The sacrificed artifact's LTB triggers are doubled. Chain from Wellsprings up to combo pieces.

synergies.title: Karn Flash Stax
synergies.description: Karn is a legendary planeswalker, so Gandalf grants flash. Deploy Karn at instant speed to shut down all opposing artifact activated abilities — Sol Rings, Treasures, Equipment, mana rocks. Devastating against artifact-heavy metas.

synergies.title: Skullclamp + Token Death Draws
synergies.description: Equip Skullclamp to a 1/1 Myr token — it becomes 2/0 and dies immediately. Gandalf doubles Skullclamp's death trigger: draw 4 cards instead of 2. With 8 Myr tokens from Battlesphere, that's potentially 32 cards drawn for 8 equip activations.

sources.name: The Commander's Quarters — Gandalf is Gross!
sources.detail: Skullclamp doubled draw engine highlighted

synergies.title: Teshar Recursion Engine
synergies.description: Casting any historic spell (artifact, legendary, Saga) triggers Teshar to reanimate a permanent with CMC 3 or less. Every cheap artifact cast brings back a Wellspring, Myr Retriever, or Circuit Mender from the graveyard. Note: Teshar's trigger is a cast trigger, not an ETB, so Gandalf doesn't double it — but Teshar still enables the engine.

sources.name: EDHREC — 69% High Synergy
sources.detail: 69% inclusion rate as recursion engine

synergies.title: Urza's Ruinous Blast at Flash Speed
synergies.description: Legendary sorcery that exiles all nonlegendary, nonland permanents. Gandalf grants flash to legendary spells — making this an instant-speed one-sided board wipe. Your legendary creatures and all artifacts survive. Cast on an opponent's combat step for maximum devastation.

highlights.name: Panharmonicon
highlights.reason: Triples ETBs alongside Gandalf. Solemn Simulacrum ramps 3 and draws 3 on death. Myr Battlesphere creates 12 Myr. Provides redundancy for the core strategy and is itself an artifact, benefiting from Gandalf's flash ability.

sources.name: The Commander's Quarters — Gandalf is Gross!
sources.detail: Highlighted as the original panharmonicon-on-a-commander synergy

highlights.name: Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines
highlights.reason: Doubles your ETBs AND blanks opponents'. With Gandalf, your artifact/legendary ETBs fire three times while opponents get zero. Legendary creature, so Gandalf grants flash. Draws heavy removal — which means it absorbed a spell that would have hit Gandalf.

sources.name: EDHREC — 42% inclusion
sources.detail: 42% inclusion, high-impact legendary

highlights.name: The One Ring
highlights.reason: Indestructible artifact with protection from everything on ETB (cast only). Flash it in via Gandalf to survive a lethal turn. The card draw snowball — drawing 1, then 2, then 3 — is devastating with multiple ways to bounce and replay it. Legendary, so Gandalf grants flash.

sources.name: Jurassic Magic — Gandalf cEDH Deck Tech
sources.detail: The One Ring as emergency protection and card draw engine

highlights.name: Heliod, Sun-Crowned
highlights.reason: Half of the cleanest infinite combo in the deck. Indestructible enchantment creature that's difficult to remove. Legendary, so Gandalf grants flash — deploy at instant speed during an opponent's counter war for a surprise win.

sources.name: Jurassic Magic — Gandalf cEDH Deck Tech
sources.detail: Primary combo piece, flash-castable via Gandalf

highlights.name: Krark-Clan Ironworks
highlights.reason: Sacrifice outlet that generates mana. Enables the KCI + Nim Deathmantle + Myr Battlesphere infinite combo. Also fuels explosive turns by converting spent artifacts into mana for bigger plays. Core engine piece.

sources.name: ErrorDoggo — $50 Gandalf Deck Tech
sources.detail: Faster sacrifice outlet than alternatives

highlights.name: Mystic Forge
highlights.reason: Play artifacts and colorless spells from the top of your library. In a deck that's 60%+ artifacts, this effectively gives you an extra card per turn. Exile a card to dig past non-artifacts. Artifact itself, so it benefits from cost reducers.

sources.name: EDHREC — 58% High Synergy
sources.detail: 58% inclusion, high synergy with artifact-heavy builds

highlights.name: Smothering Tithe
highlights.reason: Passive Treasure generation whenever opponents draw. In a 4-player game, this creates 3+ Treasures per turn cycle. Converts opponents' card advantage into your mana advantage. Funds expensive recast of combo pieces and Gandalf after removal.

highlights.name: Enlightened Tutor
highlights.reason: Finds any artifact or enchantment at instant speed. Tutors Panharmonicon for value, Walking Ballista or Heliod for combo, KCI for sacrifice outlet, Smothering Tithe for ramp, or Skullclamp for card draw. The toolbox enabler.

highlights.name: Karn, the Great Creator
highlights.reason: Legendary planeswalker castable at flash speed via Gandalf. Static ability prevents all opposing artifact activated abilities — mana rocks, Treasures, Equipment, The One Ring. Deployed at instant speed during an opponent's turn for maximum disruption.

sources.name: Jurassic Magic — Gandalf cEDH Deck Tech
sources.detail: Flash-speed stax planeswalker highlighted

highlights.name: Oswald Fiddlebender
highlights.reason: Birthing Pod for artifacts. Sacrifice a cheap artifact to tutor one that costs 1 more, directly onto the battlefield. Gandalf grants flash (legendary). Chain Ichor Wellspring into combo pieces while drawing 2 from the Wellspring's doubled LTB.

sources.name: EDHREC — 70% High Synergy
sources.detail: 70% inclusion rate, highest synergy creature

highlights.name: Myr Battlesphere
highlights.reason: Creates 8 Myr tokens with Gandalf (4 doubled to 8). 12 total power across 9 bodies. Tokens fuel Skullclamp, KCI, and Arcbound Ravager. The primary token generator and combo piece for the KCI + Nim Deathmantle infinite loop.

sources.name: Command Power — Gandalf Deck Tech
sources.detail: Signature Gandalf token play

highlights.name: Arcbound Ravager
highlights.reason: Free sacrifice outlet that grows. Each artifact sacrificed adds a +1/+1 counter. On death, modular transfers double counters with Gandalf. Enables the recursion loop without needing KCI, and threatens lethal commander damage with counter transfers.
